scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: What is this? It has been three days, and the work is still not finished. Are you guys just wasting time?
Ramesh says: Sir, the delay is not from our side. We completed the brickwork yesterday. We are just waiting for the cement supply.
Rahul says: Wait... how are you speaking such good English?
Ramesh says: Supernova AI, sir.
Rahul says: Supernova?
Ramesh says: Yes. I practice speaking with Miss Nova, my personal AI teacher. She tests my level and builds a custom plan just for me.
Ramesh says: I can make a thousand mistakes, and she corrects me without ever judging or laughing.
Ramesh says: She even explains the logic in my own language. With just fifteen minutes of practice a day, I started seeing visible progress in a month.
Rahul says: But a personal AI teacher... that must be expensive, right?
Ramesh says: Not at all. It is much more affordable than regular coaching classes.
Rahul says: Very impressive. I will tell my son to install this app.
Ramesh says: Sure, sir. The work will be completed on time.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Workplace confrontation flipped by fluent English
- Payload: Lands personalization (a) and privacy/no-judgement (b) early
- Payload: Adds logic in mother tongue (g) and hedged progress expectation
